stem:
The diagram shows Esha keeping the metal point fixed at E with the compass open to a fixed length, and moving only the pencil.

What path does the pencil draw?

options.text: A circle with centre E, and with every pencil point at the same fixed distance from E.
A circle whose radius is the point E.
A circle with centre at the moving pencil tip, and with E on the rim.
A triangle that has one vertex fixed at E.

teacher.key_rationale: Fixed point at E and fixed opening make every pencil position the same distance from E, so the path is a circle centred at E. Calling E the radius swaps terms. Putting the centre at the pencil reverses roles. A triangle confuses the compass motion with a polygon construction.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote right triangle source into a compass arc at E; stem refers to the diagram.
